question: Who among the following authors wrote "The Living Mountain"?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __Amitav Ghosh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• “The Living Mountain” is a new storybook written during the pandemic by Jnanpith winner and internationally renowned author Amitav Ghosh.
 
• It's a cautionary tale about how humans have systematically manipulated nature, leading to an environmental collapse in our time. 
 
• The Living Mountain will be published as a special standalone edition by HarperCollins Publishers India in January 2022 under its prestigious Fourth Estate imprint.
 
• The book will also be released in Hindi, as well as as an ebook and an audiobook.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• Amitav Ghosh is an Indian writer who won the 54th Jnanpith award for his work in English literature.
 
• Ghosh's works include The Circle of Reason (his 1986 debut novel), The Shadow Lines (1988), The Glass Palace (2000), The Hungry Tide (2004), and Sea of Poppies (2008), the first volume of The Ibis trilogy, set in the 1830s just before the Opium War and encapsulating the East's colonial history.
 
• On November 20, 2016, Ghosh was honored with a lifetime achievement award at Tata Literature Live, the Mumbai LitFest.
